title: Share the standard Base64 encoder across core wire paths
goal: Vision: V-6. Reuse one standard encoder for A2A binary parts, HTTP proxy authorization and OpenAI-compatible embedding results, preserving the established byte encodings and standalone operation.

reuse.searched: Reuse the padded Base64 serializer already used by the HTTP transport. Compared the A2A and embedding implementations and preserved their byte-level contracts.
